summary.text: Esme Cole is a Democrat who has represented Windsor-6 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2023.
She sits on the House Committee on Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Cole has been a lifelong resident of White River Junction, attended Hartford High School, and graduated from Kenyon College with a BA in International Studies and a minor in Biology, according to her House biography.
She has also taken a graduate course in ecological economics at the University of Vermont toward a certificate in Community Resilience and Planning.

Early in her career she interned at the Vermont Department of Health and then worked as an operations coordinator, classroom aide and manager of a child and adult food access program at an early childhood education nonprofit.
She later served as operations manager for the nonprofit Music to Life and, most recently, as a licensed dental assistant at Upper Valley Endodontics.
Her civic roles include vice chair of the Hartford Energy Commission and board membership at Positive Tracks and the Public Banking Institute.
